articleTitle: A New Fixed Point Theorem and Simple Approximative Algorithm for Nonexpansive Mappings
publicationTitle: 2011 International Symposium on Computer Science and Society
abstract: The purpose of this article is to prove a new fixed point theorem and to establish a simple approximative method of fixed point for nonexpansive mappings in the reflexive Banach space. The new fixed point theorem presented in this article improved and extend the classical results of Goebel-Kirk, Kim-Xu and many others.

articleTitle: Gill Autoleveller Intelligent Control System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Symposium on Computer Science and Society
abstract: The issue is the sub-topic of the special issue of preliminary studies of Ministry of Science and Technology 973 Plan. This paper introduces a new type of hybrid ring Auto leveller intelligent control system used in wool gill, the system adopts PLC as control platform with the full use of its fast speed, good reliability advantages. This paper focuses on the Auto leveller intelligent control system structure and control process, and system control strategies preliminary studied. The innovation of this paper is the use of intelligent sensor technology, the ratio of partition intelligent control technology, and the decoupling control technology to improve the control precision of the system to achieve the design requirements of the system, creating a good economic and social benefits.

articleTitle: Research of Real-Time Data OPC Asynchronous Communication in Incentive-Type Simulator
publicationTitle: 2011 International Symposium on Computer Science and Society
abstract: This paper describes the working principle of OPC technology, combined with incentive-type simulator working mechanism, and given the development method of OPC asynchronous communication and the concrete realization using Visual C + +6.0. Using memory-mapped file to set up real-time database for system running, through memory-mapped file to open shared memory area and to operate its data. This method can realize the sharing of process data, and ensures the real-time responsiveness to Ovation DCS server database to read and write data. With faster data transfer rates, security and high reliability in the thermal power plant automation has a strong versatility and practicality.

articleTitle: Research on Securities Companies' Core Competitiveness in the Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Symposium on Computer Science and Society
abstract: Due to a lack of core competitiveness, securities companies have a vicious competition by low commission in Tian Jin area. On the base of Nonaka' knowledge management model, the particle discussed the process about the formation of securities companies' core competitiveness. And we also give out that the path how to formate core competitiveness of the securities companies.

articleTitle: Organization and Construction Strategies for Online Learning Resources in Lifelong Learning Based on Problems Discovery
publicationTitle: 2011 International Symposium on Computer Science and Society
abstract: In order to make up the early missing education and keep up with the requirement of career, or just to be make oneself happier, lifelong learning has been one of the most urgent demands for every person. Online learning resources construction is an essential task to carry out and develop lifelong learning for more people. However, there still exist many problems, such as scarce of sharing mechanism, serious re-construction, non-structure and semistructure resources organization, etc. This paper aims at the existing problems and puts forward five strategies for organization and construction of online learning resources. It also provides a research and development network framework with blended topology by universities and agencies nodes.

articleTitle: Management of Semiconductor Manufacture--A Discussion on Multi-class Classification of Imbalanced Structure of IC Package Database
publicationTitle: 2011 International Symposium on Computer Science and Society
abstract: In the past, for the imbalance class distribution, in most cases the representative class data were chosen by sampling, in order to improve the efficacy of the class distribution model in predicting the minority of classes in the imbalanced data set. The research attempts to present a new pre-processing method of data - the Orthogonal Transformation Method (OTM), which, by integrating the conceptions of Taguchi Orthogonal Arrays, without changing the original data structure, improves the Orthogonality of the data structure by adding variables so that the accuracy of the automatic class distribution database of IC products of imbalanced data set is improved, the range of information retrieval is accurately narrowed, the efficiency and the quality of retrieval can be exalted to a great extent and thus the performance of IC design is upgraded. For the first year, the programs to be implemented and expected results are: Orthogonal Transformation Method, programming and performance evaluation.

articleTitle: Design and Implemention on Geological Information Visualization System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Symposium on Computer Science and Society
abstract: In the practical work of geology, the geological information is complex and uncertain, so we urgently need to study and develop the system of geological information visualization. The paper designed and implemented the interactive visualization system of geological information based on the modeling of triangle faces. In the system we use DEM model to express the terrain surface data, use the combination of triangle faces to express the irregular object underground, use perspective 3D landscape method and 2Dsection method to display the geological information. It proved that it provides strong supporting for researchers to find the law behind the geological information.

articleTitle: Event-Related Potential Evidence of Similarities and Differences between Prospective Memory and Vigilance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Symposium on Computer Science and Society
abstract: There are several similarities between prospective memory (PM) and vigilance, the present study aimed to examine the relationship between PM and vigilance using event-related potentials (ERP). Behavioral results indicated that PM showed longer reaction time and less accuracy than vigilance. The ERP data revealed that PM and vigilance did not show significant difference during 200-400ms in occipital region, i.e., the cue detection process, vigilance evoked more parietal positivity (related to categorization and monitoring process) than PM, but it may be related to the difference of ongoing task and non-target trials, PM evoked more negative slow wave in frontal region, suggesting post-retrieval evaluations of PM.

articleTitle: Design and Application of a Press Data Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Symposium on Computer Science and Society
abstract: In processing waste water, we design a press data acquisition system to accurately measure press of output tube. The system is comprised of 16-bit ADS8361 and 8-bit AW60. The design of the system includes hardware design and software design. Component design method is adopted in order to clear structure and increase readability and maintainability no matter what hardware design or software design. In addition, test results and designing experience are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: The Design of Laser-Based Ultra-high Warning Device of a Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Symposium on Computer Science and Society
abstract: In this article, a laser launching and receiving device is designed, it can judge whether a vehicle is ultrahigh or not. This device includes pre-judge system, signal processing circuits, vehicle location determine circuits and warning system. It can determine accurately whether a vehicle running in multi-lane road is ultra-high, and give warning in time, to ensure the safety of vehicles and its crew and bridge.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Online Detection System for Alkali Concentration and Automatic Controlling System of Dosing Alkali
publicationTitle: 2011 International Symposium on Computer Science and Society
abstract: This selected topic is the sub-topic of the first Ministry of Science and Industrial Technology Innovation Alliance Item and Tianjin Science and Technology Projects. This paper introduces alkali concentration intelligent online detection and automatic control system. Design and implementation of hardware and software systems are also detailedly described. The paper's innovation about the project is design of the alkali concentration measuring device and the liquid level control system and selection of control process.

articleTitle: The Research of Social Characteristics on Chinese Female Scientific Elites--Taking the Female Academicians of CAS for Example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Symposium on Computer Science and Society
abstract: This paper analyzed the relative data, compared them with female Nobel Prize winners, research on social characteristics of Chinese female scientific elites. The result shows that the work of geography, background and family are the important social factors of the Chinese female scientific elites.

articleTitle: The Applied Research on Virtualization of Server in Campus Network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Symposium on Computer Science and Society
abstract: During the process of digital campus construction, there emerged many problems, such as, the rapid rise of the servers in DC (Data Center) and the power consumption, various failure of single point. In order to solve these problems, the author proposes virtual server based on virtual software to improve the efficiency of equipment and reduce the energy consumption and thus reducing operating costs.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of In-Circuit Programming for Flash Memory in HCS08 MCU Family
publicationTitle: 2011 International Symposium on Computer Science and Society
abstract: On the basis of analysis of the characteristics of flash memory in HCS08 MCU family, how to perform program and erase operations are demonstrated during in-circuit programming of flash memory in HCS08 MCU family. In order to solve the unstable problem during in-circuit programming of flash memory, three methods are put forward. After studying on the features of the three methods, the implementation of the methods is given. During the debugging, MC9S08AW60 MCU is chose to verify the feasibility of the methods, and the experiment experience is supplied. The paper plays an importance role in in-circuit programming of flash memory in HCS08 MCU family.

articleTitle: Generative Experimentation and Social Simulation: Exploring Gaming for Model Verification and Validation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Symposium on Computer Science and Society
abstract: The agent-based modeling paradigm has been actively applied to address social normative issues such as: values, cognition, morality and behaviors. The abstraction of human and human-like social processes and mechanisms result in misalignment of computational model with existing (old) verification and validation techniques and expose significant challenges. We argue that human sources represent a sound approach for verification and validation of agent-based social simulation models. We propose a novel conceptual gaming framework that extracts required information from relevant sources as part of game play.

articleTitle: Visual Modeling and Representations of Spatiotemporal Transportation Data: An Object-Oriented Approach
publicationTitle: 2011 International Symposium on Computer Science and Society
abstract: Information technologies are widely applied to present the investigation and exploration of the modeling approaches involving spatial, temporal and spatio temporal data in a geography information system (GIS) framework. This paper introduces a visual object-oriented modeling approach which is applied to the modeling and representations of spatio temporal transportation data, and is supported by the unified modeling language (UML). The modeling process implements the adaption, integration and extensions of spatial and temporal UML-based semantics based on the plug-in for visual languages (PVLs) for accommodating the descriptions of dynamic transportation system. The study presented in this paper implements the representations and maintains of the multiple properties, relationships and behavioral changes of transportation data. This promotes the cognition of the complex process of transportation objects, activities and phenomena, particularly the visual modeling and representations of spatio temporal transportation data in the context of a dynamic transportation system. Also, it offers a media to enhance means of communication between model designers and transportation professionals.
